summary: This week brought a mix of high-profile commentary and sobering developments in the UAP space. Vice President JD Vance doubled down on his public interest in UFO files, telling NewsNation he's "obsessed" with the topic while characterizing potential extraterrestrial visitors as "demons," prompting pushback from Harvard astrophysicist Avi Loeb. The community also mourned the death of Nick Pope, the former UK Ministry of Defence official who became a central figure in UAP research and disclosure advocacy. On the lighter side, singer Kacey Musgraves described what she called her "craziest orb UFO experience" during a flight, adding another celebrity sighting to the public record. Meanwhile, a growing list of deceased and missing scientists connected to UAP-adjacent fields has drawn renewed attention, and several archived government documents from 2023 and 2024 were added to the public record this week.
